Composite ICU notice, not Unicode-only approval. Unicode-3.0 primary text; historical ICU permission terms; cjdict Google/TaBE BSD-3-Clause, Tsai attribution and IPADIC/NAIST with ICOT no-warranty and distribution-law condition; Lao BSD-2-Clause, Burmese BSD-3-Clause; TZ public-domain statement; double-conversion BSD-3-Clause; nlohmann/json MIT. Included notices do not establish which build scripts/data/code are linked or distributed; GPL/exceptions, IPADIC/ICOT, public-domain and mixed applicability require explicit lead policy review.
